newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Metals markets to stay soft in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Metals markets to stay soft in Q2.

text.p: Commercial Metals Co said Wednesday that its markets will remain soft in the second quarter but it expects consumption in the U.S. to reaccelerate in the spring.
The metal and steel products recycler said it expects its other markets around the globe to improve once inventory levels are further corrected.

On Wednesday the company reported net earnings of $9.2 million or $0.60 per share on sales of $527 million for the first quarter ended November 30. Net earnings for the year-ago quarter were $10.8 million or $0.70 per share.
